verdict_reason: Prior doc findings #1, #3 and #34 are resolved; one Minor gap in the new retirement rule, which omits shared v0.3.0 mappers.

todos.issue: The retirement rule says to delete a version's mappers and keep only its records when a later version uses them, but v0.4.0 also uses the v0.3.0 mappers (PimsGbnAgDataMapperV4 injects PimsConsignmentMapperV3 and PimsCommonMapperV3). Followed as written, retiring v0.3.0 deletes mappers v0.4.0 needs.
todos.fix: Must: the retirement rule keeps any record or mapper a later version still uses. One way: end the sentence 'and its records and mappers unless a later version uses them'.
